# M7 reference: A2A, MCP authorization, ACP (checked 24 Oct 2026)

Facts verified against official sources (specs, official SDK source and npm tarballs, vendor docs). **[UNVERIFIED]** marks what could not be confirmed. Versions drift: re-check before upgrading.

## 1. A2A (Agent2Agent) v1.0

- **Spec:** v1.0.0 (12 Mar 2026), patch v1.0.1 (28 May 2026, text fixes). Wire version `"1.0"`; clients MUST send `A2A-Version: 1.0` (missing = 0.3). https://a2a-protocol.org/latest/specification/
- **Bindings:** JSON-RPC 2.0 over HTTP(S) with SSE (§9, `application/json`), gRPC (§10), HTTP+JSON/REST (§11, `application/a2a+json`). None is mandatory; an agent lists every binding it offers and clients pick the first they support. JSON-RPC is the de facto default.
- **Agent Card** at `/.well-known/agent-card.json`. Required: `name`, `description`, `version`, `supportedInterfaces[{url, protocolBinding: "JSONRPC"|"GRPC"|"HTTP+JSON", protocolVersion, tenant?}]`, `capabilities{streaming?, pushNotifications?, extensions[], extendedAgentCard?}`, `defaultInputModes[]`, `defaultOutputModes[]`, `skills[{id, name, description, tags[], examples?, inputModes?, outputModes?, securityRequirements?}]`. Optional: `provider{organization, url}`, `documentationUrl`, `iconUrl`, `securitySchemes`, `securityRequirements`, `signatures`. v1.0 removed top-level `url`, `protocolVersion`, `preferredTransport`, `additionalInterfaces`; `security` became `securityRequirements`.
- **Security schemes** (map, one member each): `apiKeySecurityScheme{location, name}`, `httpAuthSecurityScheme{scheme, bearerFormat?}`, `oauth2SecurityScheme{flows…}`, `openIdConnectSecurityScheme{openIdConnectUrl}`, `mtlsSecurityScheme{}`. Requirements: `[{schemes:{<name>:{list:[scopes]}}}]`. Credentials go in HTTP headers on every request; the server MUST authenticate every request.
- **JSON-RPC methods (PascalCase):** `SendMessage`, `SendStreamingMessage`, `GetTask`, `ListTasks`, `CancelTask`, `SubscribeToTask`, push-config CRUD, `GetExtendedAgentCard`. (0.3's `message/send` etc. are gone.)
- **Shapes:** `SendMessageRequest{message, configuration?{acceptedOutputModes, historyLength, returnImmediately}, metadata?}` → `{task}` or `{message}`. `Message{messageId, role: ROLE_USER|ROLE_AGENT, parts, contextId?, taskId?, metadata?}`. `Part` = exactly one of `text` | `raw` (base64) | `url` | `data`, plus `mediaType?`, `filename?`. No `kind` discriminators. `Task{id, contextId?, status{state, message?, timestamp?}, artifacts[{artifactId, name?, parts}], history[]}`.
- **TaskState:** `TASK_STATE_SUBMITTED|WORKING|COMPLETED|FAILED|CANCELED|INPUT_REQUIRED|REJECTED|AUTH_REQUIRED` (+ `UNSPECIFIED`). Terminal: completed, failed, canceled, rejected. Interrupted: input-required, auth-required.
- **Streaming:** each SSE event is a `StreamResponse` with exactly one of `task | message | statusUpdate | artifactUpdate`; `TaskStatusUpdateEvent{taskId, contextId, status}` (no `final`: the stream closing ends it), `TaskArtifactUpdateEvent{taskId, contextId, artifact, append, lastChunk}`.
- **JS SDK:** `@a2a-js/sdk` 1.3.0 (29 Sep 2026), implements v1.0 (opt-in 0.3 compat). Server: `DefaultRequestHandler(card, taskStore, executor)`, `InMemoryTaskStore`, `AgentExecutor{execute(ctx, eventBus), cancelTask}`, framework-agnostic `JsonRpcTransportHandler.handle(body, callContext)` (response or async generator for streams); Express helpers only. Client: `ClientFactory` + `JsonRpcTransportFactory({fetchImpl})`, `createFromUrl` / `createFromAgentCard`, `sendMessage`, `sendMessageStream`, `getTask`, `cancelTask`. SDK TS types are protobuf-generated (numeric enums, `{content:{$case}}` parts) and differ from wire JSON.
- **Test agent:** the SDK's `sample-agent` (no keys: submitted → working → text artifact → completed).

## 2. MCP authorization (remote) and stdio

- **Spec revision 2026-07-28** (request-scoped version via `MCP-Protocol-Version` header and `_meta`; `server/discover`). Legacy revisions (≤ 2025-11-25) use initialize.
- **Authorization:** optional; HTTP servers SHOULD follow it, stdio SHOULD NOT (credentials from the environment). Servers MUST publish RFC 9728 Protected Resource Metadata (`authorization_servers` required) via `WWW-Authenticate: Bearer resource_metadata="…"` on 401 or the well-known URL (path-inserted `/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource/mcp`, then root). Insufficient scope: 403 with `error="insufficient_scope"`. Authorization servers MUST offer RFC 8414 or OIDC discovery; PKCE S256 (clients refuse without `code_challenge_methods_supported`); RFC 8707 `resource` on authorize and token requests and audience validation (no token passthrough); refresh-token rotation for public clients. Client registration: Client ID Metadata Documents SHOULD; DCR (RFC 7591) MAY and deprecated.
- **TS SDK:** `@modelcontextprotocol/sdk` 1.32.x speaks up to 2025-11-25; the 2.x split packages (`@modelcontextprotocol/server` 2.4.0, `node`, `fastify` 2.0.x) carry 2026-07-28 code. 2.x dropped the authorization server; it offers fetch-style resource-server helpers (`verifyBearerToken`, `requireBearerAuth`, `buildOAuthProtectedResourceMetadata`).
- **Better Auth 1.7.12:** `@better-auth/oauth-provider`, `@better-auth/mcp` (wraps it) and `@better-auth/cimd` (CIMD, `metadataProfile: "mcp-2026-07-28"`), with `jwt()` for signing and `/jwks`. Endpoints `/oauth2/authorize|token|register|consent|introspect|userinfo`, PRM at `/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource`. PKCE S256 required; DCR off unless enabled; `mcp({resource})` binds the token audience; consent page via `consentPage` and `oauth2.consent`. Token verification: `requireMcpAuth`, `createMcpProtectedRequestHandler`, or `verifyAccessTokenRequest` (JWT claims, `sub` = user).
- **Clients:** Claude Code `claude mcp add --transport http <name> <url>` then `/mcp` (DCR or CIMD; random callback port unless `--callback-port`); Cursor (PKCE + DCR; callback `http://localhost:8787/callback`); Codex `codex mcp add <name> --url <url>` + `codex mcp login` (CIMD or DCR), or `bearer_token_env_var`. Stdio servers get tokens via env (`claude mcp add --transport stdio --env BRIO_TOKEN=… brio -- brio mcp`).

## 3. ACP (Agent Client Protocol)

- JSON-RPC 2.0, newline-delimited over stdio, agent as subprocess. Wire `protocolVersion` = integer `1` (schema 1.26.0; v2 draft experimental). Official TS library `@agentclientprotocol/sdk` 2.0.1 (22 Oct 2026); 2.0.0 removed `ClientSideConnection` — use `acp.client({name}).onRequest(…).connectWith(acp.ndJsonStream(…), …)`.
- **Client → agent:** `initialize{protocolVersion:1, clientCapabilities{fs{readTextFile,writeTextFile}, terminal}, clientInfo}` → `{agentCapabilities{loadSession, promptCapabilities, mcpCapabilities{http,sse}}, authMethods}`; `authenticate{methodId}`; `session/new{cwd, mcpServers[]}` → `{sessionId}`; `session/prompt{sessionId, prompt: ContentBlock[]}` → `{stopReason: end_turn|max_tokens|max_turn_requests|refusal|cancelled}`; `session/cancel` (notification).
- **Agent → client:** `session/request_permission{toolCall, options[{optionId, kind: allow_once|allow_always|reject_once|reject_always}]}` → `{outcome:{outcome:"selected", optionId}}` (every request must be answered); `fs/read_text_file`, `fs/write_text_file`, `terminal/*`. Notifications `session/update` with `agent_message_chunk`, `agent_thought_chunk`, `tool_call`, `tool_call_update`, `plan`, `usage_update{used, size, cost?{amount, currency}}` (the only cost signal), and others.
- **MCP servers in sessions:** stdio `{name, command, args, env[]}` (all agents), `{type:"http", name, url, headers[]}` when `mcpCapabilities.http`. Cursor's docs only describe `.cursor/mcp.json` servers **[UNVERIFIED that it honours client-supplied servers]**.
- **CLIs:** Cursor `cursor-agent acp` (native; `--api-key`/`CURSOR_API_KEY`); Gemini CLI `gemini --acp` (native); OpenCode `opencode acp`; Goose `goose acp`; Claude Code and Codex only through adapters in the ACP org (`@agentclientprotocol/claude-agent-acp`, `@agentclientprotocol/codex-acp`), not vendor-published; Antigravity via a separate registry binary **[UNVERIFIED officially]**; Aider none. Brio passes keys via env and never picks a browser/OAuth `authenticate` method.

## 4. Amazon Nova Act (actuation protocol, for docs/vendors/research-browser.md §11)

Read from the official `nova-act` 3.4.187.0 wheel (PyPI; not executed) and the AWS service model `nova-act/2025-08-22/service-2.json`.

- **Auth:** SigV4 only (`signingName nova-act`, `https://nova-act.us-east-1.amazonaws.com`). The API-key endpoint `api.nova.amazon.com` is a separate nova.amazon.com service. IAM example: `nova-act:*`.
- **Operations:** `PUT /workflow-definitions` `{name}` (must exist; 409 = exists) · `PUT /workflow-definitions/{name}/workflow-runs` `{modelId ("nova-act-latest"), clientInfo{compatibilityVersion: 1, sdkVersion?}}` → `{workflowRunId, status}` · `PUT …/workflow-runs/{runId}/sessions` `{}` → `{sessionId}` · `PUT …/sessions/{sessionId}/acts` `{task, toolSpecs?[{name, description, inputSchema{json}}]}` → `{actId, status}` · `PUT …/acts/{actId}/invoke-step/` `{callResults[{callId, content[{text}]}], previousStepId?}` → `{stepId, calls[{callId, name, input}]}` · `PUT …/acts/{actId}` `{status: SUCCEEDED|FAILED, error?{message, type?}}` · `PUT …/workflow-runs/{runId}` `{status}` · `POST /models?clientCompatibilityVersion=1` (ListModels).
- **First step:** no `previousStepId`; callResults `initiateAct` → `"{}"` and `takeObservation` → observation JSON. Later steps pass the last `stepId`.
- **Calls:** `name` may carry `browser.` / `tool.` prefixes. Built-ins take a positional `input` array: `agentClick [box, clickType?]` (`left|left-double|right`), `agentHover [box]`, `agentScroll [direction, box]`, `agentType [value, box, pressEnter?]`, `goToUrl [url]`, `wait [seconds]`, `waitForPageToSettle []`, `takeObservation []`, `think [text]`, `return [value?]` (ends, success), `throw`/`throwAgentError [message]` (ends, failure). Tool calls take a dict.
- **Boxes:** `<box>top,left,bottom,right</box>` in viewport CSS pixels, or `<bbox>left,top,right,bottom</bbox>` (or bare) normalised 0–1000; act at the centre. Which form the service emits is **[UNVERIFIED]**: accept both.
- **Results:** `content[{text}]`; success → `JSON.stringify(returnValue)` (actions return `null`); error → `"<ErrorType>: <message>"` and the act fails. Observation: `{activeURL, browserDimensions{scrollHeight, scrollLeft, scrollTop, scrollWidth, windowHeight, windowWidth}, idToBboxMap:{}, screenshotBase64:"data:image/jpeg;base64,…" (viewport only, JPEG q90), simplifiedDOM:"", timestamp_ms, userAgent}`. Recommended viewport 1600×813 (±20%).
- **Human in the loop:** tool specs `human_Approve` and `human_UiTakeover` (`{message: string}`, fixed descriptions); answer `"\"yes\""` / `"\"complete\""`; a cancel fails the act.
- **Pricing:** $4.75 per agent-hour.
